description: This source file is a shell script that contains test cases for verifying the behavior of 'git rebase' with rewording via a custom testing library. It sets up a repository, performs rebase operations, and checks commit messages and history to ensure correctness.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, taking a description string and commands to execute, verifying expected outcomes.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers commands to run after the test completes, typically cleanup actions.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail, used to test error conditions.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of all test cases in the script.
